thread:
alex: Passing Pacific Health over to CS — enterprise deal, Dedicated capacity committed, private/VPC option requested. Go-live target ~6 weeks. Key contacts: Lisa Park (CTO), Marco Ruiz (eng lead). Open risks: SSO cert timing, EHR integration questions, data residency confirmation. Estimated steady qps ~12, peaks ~60, token estimate ~8M/mo. Contract + sales notes in SF: https://sales.internal/opp/PH-328 (see attachments).
priya: Thanks — assigning owners for onboarding. Priya (CSAM) + Sam (Solutions) will drive kickoff. What creds/test org do we have? Any sample prompts or golden outputs?
alex: Sharing trial org + creds in a DM. Sample prompt set pasted below (redacted):
```
// patient-summary prompt #1
"Summarize the patient's last 3 visits focusing on meds, allergies, and follow-ups."
```
sam: Got the sample prompts. We'll need a sanitized golden set for quality checks. Also need expected traffic patterns by hour and largest prompt sizes. alex — can you confirm token distribution?
alex: Peak prompt length ~800 tokens, average ~220. Mostly chat-style summaries + classification. Non-PHI dev data will be used for evals; they asked for audit logging and 12mo retention. Legal flagged a couple items but gave preliminary OK if we redact PHI at source.
jules: Looping infra eng in — would like their expected IP ranges and whether they're using private DNS. Also HSM/KMS for key management is a hard requirement? If yes, we need SOC docs and KMS onboarding lead.
alex: They require KMS integration (customer KMS) and want HSM-backed key protection. IP ranges: 52.12.34.0/24, 18.9.120.0/22. Region: us-west-2 primary, eu-west-1 DR. I'll attach the network diagram.
marta: Support here — we'll create a dedicated queue and runbook. Who will be the escalation owner from ENG? Need an oncall contact and expected SLA for P1/P2.
priya: I'll own the escalation runbook and create the Jira epic CS-3421. Eng owner = jules for infra work; oncall fallback will be eng-oncall @eng-oncall. SLA agreed in contract: P1 1hr, P2 4hr.
jules: For rollout, propose canary at 10% traffic to Dedicated pool for 48h, monitor 95p latency, error rate, token cost delta, and output drift against golden set. Also plan a fallback to hosted model variant if latency or cost spikes.
sam: We'll need eval harness and automated regression alerts tied to prompt set. Priya, can you confirm who on the customer side will give access to golden outputs? alex, please confirm legal redaction timeline.
alex: I'll get customer permission this week; legal asked for a short DPIA and redaction process — I'll loop legal and share the doc.
priya: Next steps (owners):
  1) CS kickoff meeting Tue 03/26 10:00 PT — invite sent (Priya, Sam, Lisa P, Marco)
  2) Solution-eng deep dive Wed 03/27 — tech details & network (Sam, Jules, Alex)
  3) Provision Dedicated pool by 04/05 (Infra: Jules)
  4) KMS/HSM onboarding & contract signoff by 04/08 (Legal + Jules + Alex)
  5) SSO (SAML) test by 04/10 (Priya + Customer IAM)
  6) Canary rollout & smoke test by 04/15 (Sam + Jules)
  7) Post-canary enablement + support playbook live by 04/20 (Marta + Priya)
I'll open CS-ONB-592 and attach this checklist.
jules: Adding monitoring thresholds to ENG-9102 and creating a pre-provision checklist. Need the customer's peering CIDRs and route table details before provisioning.
marta: I'll draft the support playbook template and sample runbook steps (SSO failover, cert rotation, incident run). Will attach to the Jira epic.
alex: Also FYI — renewal cadence: 12mo, strong expansion potential if latency <200ms and error <0.5% for 90 days post-GO. Upsell motion: bring Dedicated sizing + cost forecast in QBR.
sam: Noted — we'll instrument cost dashboards and token-level tracking. Can we get a sample of their daily traffic CSV for the past month? alex please ask customer.
alex: On it. Will push CSV to the SF opp and grant access to CS+Eng.
priya: OK — owners locked. Please react with :thumbsup: if you acknowledge tasks, or add quick blockers.
jules: :thumbsup:
marta: :white_check_mark:
alex: :rocket:
deploy-bot: Created ticket ENG-9102 for infra provisioning and CS-ONB-592 for onboarding checklist.
priya: Thanks team — closing the loop here. I'll post follow-ups and attach the legal POC once we have it.
